rules.text: A change to headings 7501 through 7505 from any other heading.

(A) A change to heading 7506 from any other heading; or
(B) A change to foil, not exceeding 0.15 mm in thickness, from any other good of heading 7506, provided that there has been a reduction in thickness of no less than 50 percent.
A change to subheadings 7507.11 through 7508.90 from any other subheading.
